wiki.title: Howard Penny Jr.
wiki.extract: Howard Lassiter Penny Jr. (born August 5, 1947) is an American politician who is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives. He represents the 53rd district, which includes Harnett County, North Carolina and he took the oath of office on September 17, 2020. He is a retired businessman in the agriculture industry and served on the Harnett County Commission.
